fusions.name: Gulp of Soil
fusions.desc: Sends a ripple through the ground into an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 9 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: The Swallowing Pit
fusions.desc: The ground gapes open around you, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Gorged on Minerals
fusions.desc: You gorge on salts drawn from the ground, restoring 10 health, and your maximum health rises by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Helpings
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You carry 6% physical resistance.
